title: Miso Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Brown butter, white miso, and dark chocolate. The miso adds a roasted, savory depth that makes you wonder why every cookie recipe doesn't do this.
why_it_works: Both miso and dark chocolate are rich in pyrazines from the fermentation and roasting process. The savory-sweet contrast is surprisingly addictive.

title: Cardamom Rose Latte
description: Warm milk with ground cardamom, a drop of rose water, and a touch of honey. Middle Eastern-inspired, fragrant enough to stop conversation.
why_it_works: Cardamom and rose both contain linalool and geraniol — they don't just pair well, they reinforce each other at the molecular level.

title: Truffle Parmesan Pasta
description: Fresh pasta with truffle oil, freshly grated parmesan, and cracked black pepper. Four ingredients, absurd results.
why_it_works: Truffle and parmesan share glutamates — both are umami-dense. Together they create what chefs call 'umami stacking': each amplifies the other.

title: Lemon Lavender Shortbread
description: Buttery shortbread with lemon zest and dried lavender. Goes well with Earl Grey. Goes better on its own.
why_it_works: Lemon and lavender both contain linalool — a floral-citrus monoterpene that creates a seamless bridge between the two flavors. Butter's fat carries them both.

title: Smoked Paprika Honey Glaze
description: A glaze for chicken wings or roasted vegetables. The smokiness and sweetness seem opposed but they hold each other in check.
why_it_works: Guaiacol from the smoked paprika and the floral furaneol from honey shouldn't work together in theory. In practice, the fat from the meat mediates the compounds and it clicks.

title: Vanilla Coffee Panna Cotta
description: Set cream flavored with espresso and vanilla bean. Served cold. Barely sweet — lets the bitterness of the coffee do the work.
why_it_works: Coffee and vanilla share furanones from the roasting/curing process. Cream's lactones round the whole thing out into something velvety.

title: Dark Rum and Clove Spice Cake
description: A dense, fragrant loaf cake soaked in dark rum syrup. The kind of thing you make in autumn and eat in thick slices with a cup of tea.
why_it_works: Rum and clove share eugenol — the same warm spice compound. Soaking the cake in rum after baking actually pushes more eugenol into the crumb.

title: Yuzu Butter Curd
description: Like lemon curd but rounder and more complex. Yuzu's nootkatone gives it a grapefruit-like bitterness that cuts the richness of the butter.
why_it_works: Yuzu's citrus terpenes (limonene, linalool) and butter's lactones are natural complements — citrus and cream have been pairing forever, but yuzu makes it interesting.

title: Anchovy Butter Linguine
description: A Roman classic. Anchovies dissolved in butter with garlic and chilli over pasta. Nobody believes it's this good until they try it.
why_it_works: Anchovy is pure glutamates. Butter's fat carries and disperses them across every strand of pasta. It's not really anchovy-flavored pasta — it's just really savory pasta.

title: Strawberry Basil Sorbet
description: Blended fresh strawberries with torn basil and a lemon hit. Better than plain strawberry sorbet and simpler to explain than it should be.
why_it_works: Strawberry and basil both contain linalool and a touch of eugenol. The herbal note in basil lifts the strawberry and makes it taste more like strawberry, not less.

title: Roasted Beetroot Miso Soup
description: Roasted beetroot blended with miso dashi. Earthy, savory, slightly sweet. Deep red in the bowl. Looks dramatic, tastes inevitable.
why_it_works: Both beetroot and miso have significant glutamate content. Roasting the beetroot reduces its geosmin (earthy) compound and develops natural sweetness, which miso's umami anchors.

title: Banana and Clove Bread
description: Overripe bananas with ground clove and a tiny bit of cardamom. More interesting than banana bread with cinnamon — try it once and you'll never go back.
why_it_works: Banana and clove both contain eugenol — the same compound that defines cloves is also present in natural bananas. The clove brings out what's already there.

title: Lavender Honey Ice Cream
description: Heavy cream base infused with dried lavender, sweetened with good honey. Restrained — you want to taste lavender as a flavor, not a scent.
why_it_works: Lavender (linalool) and honey (furaneol, linalool, geraniol) are already sharing compounds before they ever meet in the bowl. The cream amplifies both.

title: Roasted Pineapple Rum Tart
description: Caramelized pineapple in a buttery tart shell, flambéed with dark rum. A dessert that feels more confident than it has any right to be.
why_it_works: Pineapple and rum share ethyl butanoate — the tropical ester that makes both smell the way they do. Flambéing the rum drives off alcohol and concentrates the esters.

title: Shiitake Soy Ramen Broth
description: A vegetarian ramen broth built on dried shiitake and soy sauce. The glutamate content rivals a long-cooked meat stock.
why_it_works: Shiitake and soy sauce are both glutamate-dense umami sources, but they deliver it differently — mushroom through lentionine, soy through fermentation. Together the broth tastes impossibly deep.
